subject: Creation of School-Based DEI Director Position
overview: The subcommittee discussed the district's reliance on the City's DEI Director and the need for dedicated school-level staff to manage culture, discipline, and student-facing initiatives. Members recommended that the full committee create a dedicated school-based DEI director position while establishing a formal, compensated collaboration with the city's DEI office.

items.title: Resolution 2024-40: Consolidation of DEI Support
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a resolution regarding the city's DEI director providing support for school ADA compliance, crisis management, and training needs.

items.title: Report from the City DEI Director and ADA Coordinator
items.summary: City DEI Director Frances Nwajei detailed her work providing civil rights compliance and mediation for school employees, clarifying that she does not access individual student records.

items.title: Recommendation for School-Based DEI Director and Stipend
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a recommendation that the district create a job description for a school-based DEI director to work in collaboration with the city's DEI director. The motion also recommends providing an annual stipend to the city's DEI director for this ongoing collaboration, with an amount to be recommended by the superintendent by December 16.
